reviewed_by: Codex focused review for harness catalog refresh
reason: The two selected component files cover harness mutation persistence, independent MCP failures, shared catalog recovery, and out-of-order refreshes. One production LAN Core journey in eight permanent browser profiles covers Settings and Workbench mounted together, create/check/enable/disable, preserved draft and selected chat, retained choices on a failed catalog read, and keyboard retry.
exclusions: No backend or native product behavior changes, so Python and native unit suites are excluded. The real-Core browser journey uses an existing inert adapter and synthetic data, executes no tools or provider turns, and includes deliberate browser-side read failure injection. Existing settings destinations and actions are unchanged; no new setting or assistant action is introduced. Unrelated UI suites, simulation deployment, physical devices, streaming, and provider execution are outside this catalog-refresh change.
